title: SweepReport
description: Canonical, deterministic result of a parameter sweep's robustness battery (M4). A research FILTER, not a profitability verdict: 'advanceable' means a candidate survived costs/doubled-costs/walk-forward/baseline checks and is eligible for M5 review, never that it is profitable (invariant 11). All budgets and observed/threshold values are exact decimal strings (never JSON floats).

trial_count.description: Total cells evaluated across the sweep (for M5 multiple-testing accounting).

candidates.description: Per-candidate first-class metrics: worst-window drawdown/turnover and the fee-sensitivity block (before/base/doubled). Robustness reporting only (invariant 11).

data_provenance.description: Computed rollup over the input data actually fed to the sweep (m-hf-track §2: a typed field, not prose). 'synthetic' if every item was synthetic, 'real' if every item was real, 'mixed' otherwise. Absent entirely when the sweep never computed it (all M4/M5/LF and pre-C8.2 reports).

decimalString.description: An exact decimal value encoded as a string.

Thresholds.description: Configured robustness budgets (research policy; illustrative until frozen for M5).

CandidateMetrics.description: One candidate's first-class reported metrics: worst-window drawdown and turnover plus the fee-sensitivity block.

HfRungs.description: Per-candidate HF cost-scenario ladder rollup (m-hf-track §3/§4): the three HF-only rungs' metrics plus BASE-rung sums of the everyday-economics counters (adverse selection, unlanded orders). Absent entirely on LF (M4/M5) reports.

FeeSensitivity.description: Aggregated cost-ladder metrics (before_costs/base/doubled), both return drags, and the baseline-grounded doubled-costs survival flag. The parent key of each scenario block is its discriminator.

ScenarioMetrics.description: One cost scenario's aggregated metrics, decimal-string encoded (never JSON floats).

CandidateVerdict.description: One candidate's verdict. The status <-> failed_criteria coupling ('advanceable' iff the list is empty) is enforced in code (sweep::advance::evaluate_candidate), not by the schema — following the repo convention that the schema checks shape while code enforces semantics (cf. run-result 'unitInterval').

status.description: 'advanceable' = survived the robustness battery, eligible for M5 review (NOT profitable). 'rejected' = failed at least one criterion.

RejectionReason.description: A single failed robustness criterion, recording the observed value against its threshold.
